tested by eng. Khaled El-Etreby & eng. Atef Farh, revised by 
quality control eng. Tawfik Elabasery at EDEPCo.,
and approved by eng. Monear Mahmoud El-Wakeel: Head Sector of 
 Damietta 
Power Station.

A work permit
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
 safety category,

Safety fence
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Make sure CT secondary circuits are 
 shorted.

Voltage Supply to the relay may be alive 
 even after the line is isolated.

Isolate DC supply to relay, when doing any 
 adjustments or maintenance on the relay itself

Ensure all CT path elements are secure 
 after any test disturbance.

Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedures 
 P1 for SD135A distance relay, which must be performed on an annually 
 bases Y1 as indicated in the title block.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. 
Abdel Raheem Salem Mohamed Ez, 
tested by eng. Khaled El-Etreby & eng. Atef Farh, revised by 
quality control eng. Tawfik Elabasery at EDEPCo.,
and approved by eng. Monear Mahmoud El-Wakeel: Head Sector of 
 Damietta 
Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
 safety category,
Safety fence
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Line Isolation.
Make sure CT secondary circuits are 
 shorted.
Voltage Supply to the relay may be alive 
 even after the line is isolated.
Isolate DC supply to relay, when doing any 
 adjustments or maintenance on the relay itself
Ensure all CT path elements are secure 
 after any test disturbance.

 after any test disturbance.
